task: photo-editing flagship: the D780/D600 near-clean losers' truth noise

doc_friction.issue: Start here sent this session to changepoint-detector's newest item, which PR #17740 had claimed 5 s before this session's claim; claim_check caught it, but only after a claim commit and draft PR had been opened. Two scheduled sessions starting in the same minute get the same row.

The note told the next run to 'check their truths' own noise' with truth_sigma18, which is frame_noise, the estimator under test; a literal follow-through would have closed a real loss as a scoring artefact.

deviations.why: Yielded the allocator's changepoint-detector pick to PR #17741's older twin #17740 and took photo-editing as claim_check suggested; retitled the claim PR instead of opening a new one.

My own pre-registered decision said: if --clean-truths drops all 11 losers, close the item. It did, but an independent check made after reading (EXIF ISO 100, tile images, a raw-based grain reading that matches sensor physics) showed the column reads texture as grain, so I did not close it; the 6 losers real by the raw reading became the next item, as the rule's other branch specified.
deviations.did: added truth_grain18 and reported both readings
deviations.result: 6 of 11 losers confirmed real; Bayer lift still passes h1-h3 on clean truths

goal: deepen the photo-editing flagship's noise-aware demosaic evaluation
notes: raw.pixls.us answered this session. Reran the first set's 1,272 held rows (reproduced to 0 dB difference) with a new truth_grain18 column read from each raw's sensels (tools/truth_noise_check.py), with the transfer into the binned truth measured by a second LibRaw pass with known added noise. Old truth_sigma18 read D780 ISO-100 foliage at truth SNR 13-19 vs 153-181 from the raw. 6 of 11 losers are real (frame read 2.3-5.2x the added noise, floor set by texture). rule --k 12 --clean-truths: h1-h3 PASS on 958 kept rows. Local checks: run_venture_tests.py photo-editing ok (1454 tests, 101 s); check_posts ok; validate.py ok.
